description: Expected results for the official PFLOTRAN regression test default/543/543_flow (3D Richards flow on a 5x4x3 structured grid with 4 soil materials, recharge on top, a changing east head and an injection well; 10 days in 100 steps of 0.1 d). Every expected value below is copied from the OFFICIAL gold file inputs/543_flow.regression.gold, and every tolerance is the OFFICIAL tolerance from inputs/543.cfg [default-test-criteria] (pressure 1e-12 relative, saturation 1e-12 absolute, discrete 0 absolute, generic 1e-12 absolute) or the regression_tests.py built-in default (residual 1e-12 absolute; mean of a discrete variable uses the generic tolerance). The whole gold file is also checked by PFLOTRAN's own regression_tests.py --check-only.
engine_version: PFLOTRAN v6.0 (git fab315dc6559306f2f93b27571bf5add812dd820, tag v6.0), PETSc 3.21

numeric_checks.name: pressure_mean_Pa
numeric_checks.why: mean liquid pressure over all 60 cells

numeric_checks.name: pressure_cell29_Pa
numeric_checks.why: pressure at the official check cell 29

numeric_checks.name: material_id_mean
numeric_checks.why: materials read from 543.h5 are placed right

numeric_checks.name: linear_iterations
numeric_checks.why: direct LU: one linear solve per Newton step

numeric_checks.name: solution_2norm
numeric_checks.why: norm of the final pressure field

finished_check: return code 0 from the KI run tool, and the screen output has '--> write regression output file: <path>/543_flow.regression' and 'Wall Clock Time:'; plus PFLOTRAN's own regression_tests.py --check-only prints 'All tests passed.' with exit 0
recorded_with: /mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/models/PFLOTRAN/source/repo/src/pflotran/pflotran (serial, 1 rank) run through the KI tools/run_pflotran.py; output compared by inputs/regression_tests.py
reference: Official gold file regression_tests/default/543/543_flow.regression.gold from https://bitbucket.org/pflotran/pflotran at tag v6.0 (last changed in commit cfa897925e615ff6c60efbb8bc07a8d6a8313f71). Our runs match it exactly (every value in the file is the same digit for digit; the only extra line is the run time 'Time (seconds)', which the gold file does not hold).
